title: Listening Drill — Basic dressmaking — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Basic dressmaking — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on basic dressmaking. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Wednesday. The group will now meet on Thursday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the arcade entrance; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is fabric scissors. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow forty-five minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check stitch length before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed sample seam so we can offer feedback.
